Overview.Name: Priyanka Durgalla
Overview.Goal: Fat loss, better body shape, increased energy, confidence, and stress reduction.

Early_Morning (optional): Option 1: Warm water (200 ml) + 2 boiled eggs
Option 2: Warm water (200 ml) + full fat curd (150 g)
Option 3: Warm water (200 ml) + full fat milk (200 ml)
Breakfast: Option 1: Omelette (3 eggs) with spinach (50 g) + small bowl curd (100 g)
Option 2: Boiled eggs (3) + ivory gourd curry (100 g)
Option 3: Rice poha (80 g) with scrambled eggs (2)
Lunch: Option 1: Plain rice (150 g) + chicken curry (150 g) + spinach curry (100 g) [Tue/Wed/Fri/Sat/Sun]
Option 2: Plain rice (150 g) + egg curry (2 eggs) + dal (100 g) + vegetables (100 g)
Option 3: Plain rice (150 g) + dal (150 g) + ivy gourd fry (100 g) + curd (100 g) [Mon/Thu - vegetarian]
Evening_Snack: Option 1: Puffed rice (30 g) with boiled chickpeas (50 g) + cucumber (50 g)
Option 2: Sweet corn salad (100 g corn, 50 g cucumber, 50 g tomato, lemon)
Option 3: Boiled egg whites (2 eggs) + small fruit (100 g)
Dinner: Option 1: Chicken curry (200 g) + small portion rice (80 g) + spinach (100 g) [Tue/Wed/Fri/Sat/Sun]
Option 2: Egg curry (3 eggs) + rice (80 g) + vegetable curry (100 g)
Option 3: Dal (150 g) + rice (80 g) + curd (100 g) + green gram curry (100 g) [Mon/Thu - vegetarian]

Notes_and_Tips: Monday and Thursday are vegetarian days - focus on eggs, dal, chickpeas, and curd.
Savory/spicy cravings: keep puffed rice or boiled chickpeas ready, add chilies to meals instead of fried foods.
Social gatherings: eat your regular meal before going, then take only small portions.
Late night eating: if hungry past 8 PM, have boiled eggs or curd only.
Include spinach daily for better fat loss - keep rice portions smaller at dinner.
Stay consistent with 2 main meals at times that suit your work schedule.
